description: NT DIPL - Palmerston Super Tuesday Bike Counts is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Northern Territory Government - Department of Infrastructure, Planning and Logistics. This dataset presents information and locations related to The Super Tuesday Bike Count event in Palmerston for 2017. The counts are presented as individual points which relate to the location where the counts were undertaken by volunteers. Coverage: Palmerston. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Northern Territory Government - Department of Infrastructure, Planning and Logistics. Its tags are bicycle. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
